title: metadata-protocol: a save naming a read-only code package itself (?package=<base>) for an overlay type is still accepted and lands an overlay bound to the base
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #28576 dev (os-dev-report 6568585266, `out_of_scope_findings` 1), filed by `domain:server` seat 5. Graded by this seat: p2, the sibling of #28576's close (a write that ADR-0146 D1 says lands in the base's `.custom` pair lands elsewhere). Graded under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any caller of the metadata save doors that names the installed read-only code package itself (`?package=<base>`) when saving a `view`, `dashboard`, `report`, `translation` or `email_template` that package ships.
Reader who acts: a `domain:server` seat (`packages/metadata-protocol`).

## What happens

After PR #28850 (#28576), a write that names no package onto a packaged item of the five overlay types is refused, naming the pair. A save naming the base package itself (`?package=com.acme.crm`) is still accepted, and lands an overlay row bound to the read-only base. `protocol.packageless-save-address.test.ts`'s code-package block seeds one in its second case. ADR-0146 D1 reads that customizations of a read-only package land in its `.custom` pair.

## Wanted

- Measure first: which doors (save, publish, delete, rollback) accept `?package=<read-only base>` for the five overlay types, what such a row serves, and whether the ceremony sees it.
- Then refuse it as #28576 refuses the package-less write: the same `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` sentence naming the pair, under 500 characters. Or report why D1 allows it.
- A narrowing: `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)` with a contract review, and a FROM → TO changeset.

Blocked-by: #28576 (reuses its refusal and its reading of "packaged").

Dedupe: searched `read-only code package overlay save accepted`; none. **New.**

Links back: #28576, PR #28850, ADR-0146.
